tools_helpful.tool: dotnet build -c Debug -p:Platform=x64 with BUILD_EXIT sentinel
tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt turns 65-68: sync builds with an explicit '"BUILD_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"' final line gave the agent a clean readable result every turn.

tool_limitations.limitation: It rewrites Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml but does not reconcile the app root namespace: the scaffold uses ProjectName as RootNamespace while the copied source files keep their own namespace (SDKTemplate), leaving a split-namespace project the agent must fix by hand.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Detect the source's dominant root namespace and set the scaffold's <RootNamespace> to match (or at least warn when ProjectName != source namespace).

doc_errors.wrong: 'Migrate references to system brushes / styles to {ThemeResource}' — applied to a Style.BasedOn reference this produces XamlCompiler error WMC0141.
doc_errors.correct: Style.BasedOn must resolve at XAML-compile time and requires {StaticResource} (or a direct key); only brush/value setters that must swap on theme change use {ThemeResource}. BasedOn must never use {ThemeResource}.

special_apis.special_handling: The WinRT type name equals the SDK sample's folder/app name. Naming the WinUI project (RootNamespace) 'ActivitySensor' shadows the type and yields CS0118 'namespace but is used like a type'. Keep the project/root namespace off the demonstrated API's name (use the source's SDKTemplate).

errors_encountered.error: 3_ChangeEvents.xaml.cs(33,17): error CS0118: 'ActivitySensor' is a namespace but is used like a type
errors_encountered.root_cause: Project scaffolded with 'dotnet new winui -n ActivitySensor' -> RootNamespace 'ActivitySensor' collides with the Windows.Devices.Sensors.ActivitySensor type the sample uses unqualified.
errors_encountered.fix: Set <RootNamespace> to the source namespace 'SDKTemplate' and align App/MainWindow namespaces to it (session-log turns 66-68).

errors_encountered.error: App.xaml(14,14): XamlCompiler error WMC0141: Style BasedOn property must be a Style, not 'ThemeResourceExtension' object
errors_encountered.root_cause: A shared-content style (BasicTextStyle, BasedOn="{StaticResource BodyTextBlockStyle}") was migrated to BasedOn="{ThemeResource BodyTextBlockStyle}" following the over-broad 'styles -> ThemeResource' guidance; BasedOn cannot be a deferred ThemeResource lookup.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two XAML/C# compile errors (CS0118 + WMC0141) blocked the first successful build; agent had to rename the namespace across App.xaml/App.xaml.cs/MainWindow.xaml/.cs and rewrite the style.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Scaffold RootNamespace collided with the demonstrated WinRT type, and ThemeResource guidance misapplied to Style.BasedOn.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Changed RootNamespace to SDKTemplate; changed BasedOn to a plain FontSize setter.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: SKILL.md project-file reconcile step instructing RootNamespace = source root namespace (never the demonstrated API/sample name), plus a MIGRATION-PATTERNS CS0118 anchor; and correcting the ThemeResource section to exclude Style.BasedOn.

env_issues.issue: Trial results.json shows builds:false/score:0/timeout:true, but the committed code in fact builds and the score step rated it 100/100.
env_issues.workaround: The stale mid-timeout snapshot is an environment artifact; grade from committed code / score notes, not the trial results.json.
